name: GP Social Publisher
author: gayatripol

sections.description:
GP Social Publisher helps WordPress users turn published blog posts into social-ready content for platforms like LinkedIn, Facebook, and X (Twitter).

Instead of manually rewriting every blog post into multiple social formats, GP Social Publisher gives you a structured workflow:

  • Connect social accounts
  • Generate platform-ready social captions
  • Save editable drafts
  • Approve or reject content
  • Queue approved posts
  • Track actions with logs
  • Publish to supported social platforms

GP Social Publisher is built for marketers, agencies, publishers, and content teams who need a lightweight social publishing workflow directly inside WordPress.

Features

  • Connect and manage social accounts
  • Generate social content from WordPress posts
  • Platform-specific draft generation
  • Draft save / edit workflow
  • Approval workflow (Approve / Reject)
  • Queue approved content
  • Publishing logs and audit trail
  • LinkedIn publishing support
  • Facebook publishing support
  • X (Twitter) publishing placeholder ready for extension
  • Clean admin workflow UI

Workflow

  1. Connect your social account
  2. Select a published WordPress post
  3. Generate platform-ready content
  4. Edit and save drafts
  5. Approve or reject content
  6. Queue approved posts
  7. Publish automatically
  8. Review logs

External Services

This plugin connects to third-party social media APIs to publish approved social content.

LinkedIn API

This plugin sends post content and account authorization data to LinkedIn when a user publishes approved social content.

Data sent may include:
– Social post content
– Account ID
– Access token

This service is provided by LinkedIn:

Terms of Service:
https://www.linkedin.com/legal/user-agreement

Privacy Policy:
https://www.linkedin.com/legal/privacy-policy

Facebook Graph API

This plugin sends post content and account authorization data to Facebook when a user publishes approved social content.

Data sent may include:
– Social post content
– Facebook page/account ID
– Access token

This service is provided by Meta:

Terms of Service:
https://www.facebook.com/legal/terms

Privacy Policy:
https://www.facebook.com/privacy/policy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/gp-social-publisher directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Open GP Social Publisher from the WordPress admin menu.
  4. Configure settings and connect your social accounts.
sections.faq:
Which social platforms are supported?

Currently supported:
– LinkedIn
– Facebook

Planned / extendable:
– X (Twitter)
– Instagram

Does it publish automatically?

Yes. Approved posts can be queued and automatically processed for publishing.

Can I edit generated content?

Yes. Every generated draft can be edited before approval and queueing.

Does it require manual approval?

Yes. GP Social Publisher includes a built-in approval workflow before publishing.
